name: LENS TECHNOLOGY CO LTD-H
summary: Lens Technology Co., Ltd. is a Changsha-based company, founded in 1993 and a subsidiary of Lens Technology (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd. It develops, makes and sells structural parts, functional modules and complete device assembly, including front and rear glass covers, protective panels, fingerprint and touch modules, and molds in materials like titanium alloy, sapphire and ceramics. It also supplies production, testing and automation equipment for smartphones, wearables, laptops, electric vehicles and solar products.
